prompt:
You write the story panel. Write 4-6 plain-language sentences describing what the change does and what is and is not proven.
Every sentence must end with one or more claim references like [C1]. A sentence with no claim reference is invalid.
State facts, not opinions of quality. No confidence numbers.

sentences.text: Issue #2297 asks that all code the MessagePack generator emits carry ExcludeFromCodeCoverage so generated code stops skewing coverage numbers.
sentences.text_with_refs: Issue #2297 asks that all code the MessagePack generator emits carry ExcludeFromCodeCoverage so generated code stops skewing coverage numbers. [C1]

sentences.text: The change edits six T4 templates and their preprocessed outputs, regenerates 222 of 225 snapshot files, and leaves three under InterfaceUnion/ untouched.
sentences.text_with_refs: The change edits six T4 templates and their preprocessed outputs, regenerates 222 of 225 snapshot files, and leaves three under InterfaceUnion/ untouched. [C1][C5][C7]

sentences.text: The attribute is wrapped in a guard that excludes netstandard2.0 and .NET Framework, so the README's 'all generated formatters and resolvers' does not hold on those targets, and nothing compiles the output for them.
sentences.text_with_refs: The attribute is wrapped in a guard that excludes netstandard2.0 and .NET Framework, so the README's 'all generated formatters and resolvers' does not hold on those targets, and nothing compiles the output for them. [C3][C6]

sentences.text: The new test checks each generated file for the attribute and for the guard, which is weaker than checking every generated type.
sentences.text_with_refs: The new test checks each generated file for the attribute and for the guard, which is weaker than checking every generated type. [C2]

sentences.text: One hunk outside the requirement changes how braces are emitted for nested generic types with constraints, and at least one snapshot differs by more than an added attribute.
sentences.text_with_refs: One hunk outside the requirement changes how braces are emitted for nested generic types with constraints, and at least one snapshot differs by more than an added attribute. [C4]

sentences.text: On the resolver the attribute lands on the generated part of a class the user declares, which excludes the user's own members of that class from coverage too.
sentences.text_with_refs: On the resolver the attribute lands on the generated part of a class the user declares, which excludes the user's own members of that class from coverage too. [C8]
